decisions.decision: Do not lose a commit's extraction to a blank line in a quote
decisions.rationale: Refusing the whole commit for a blank line throws away work that has already been paid for.
decisions.quote: Whatever becomes a body is now joined into one paragraph, in the one place a body is chosen rather than at each call site

decisions.decision: Drop the claim of answering 'why is this like this?' as a product feature
decisions.rationale: To focus on the tool's actual capabilities rather than unmet claims.
decisions.quote: Answering "why is this like this?" was dropped as a product claim.

decisions.decision: Assign labels, sources and statuses; the model proposes wording only
decisions.rationale: To maintain control over the integrity of recorded information.
decisions.quote: The tool assigns labels, sources and statuses; the model proposes wording only.

decisions.decision: Detect staleness by item body hash rather than line ranges
decisions.rationale: To accurately track changes in code identity rather than just line positions.
decisions.quote: Staleness is attached to code identity rather than to line ranges, so a function that moved is not stale and one that changed is.

decisions.decision: Record review as confirmations, withdrawals with reasons, and closures with notes
decisions.rationale: To keep a comprehensive log of all reviews and decisions made.
decisions.quote: Review as records. Confirming writes an attestation, rejecting writes a withdrawal whose reason unit says why, closing writes a resolution.

decisions.decision: Ship its own instrument for benchmarking the model
decisions.rationale: To provide users with the ability to measure the performance of their chosen models on their own commits.
decisions.quote: It ships its own instrument. `bench` measures the model *you* chose on *your* commits, and every published figure names the model it came from.

decisions.decision: Focus on deterministic commands over model-dependent ones
decisions.rationale: To prioritize commands that are reliable, tested, and cost-effective to run.
decisions.quote: Two thirds of the commands never call a model. Those are the ones worth your time today: they are deterministic, tested, and cost nothing to run.

decisions.decision: Publish figures naming the model each came from, including failed experiments
decisions.rationale: To provide transparency about which models were tested and their results, including any failures.
decisions.quote: The figures are published, naming the model each came from, including the experiments that failed.

decisions.decision: Highlight over-production as the failure mode that matters
decisions.rationale: To emphasize the importance of avoiding unnecessary or excessive output in the tool's operations.
decisions.quote: Over-production is the failure mode that matters.

decisions.decision: Meaningfully price extraction runs before starting them
decisions.rationale: To inform users about the cost of extraction runs before they start, allowing them to make informed decisions.
decisions.quote: The hook only queues and `--estimate` prices a run before it starts.

decisions.decision: Label cloned corpora as someone else's claims
decisions.rationale: To clarify the status of units in cloned corpora, indicating that they are not the tool's own claims.
decisions.quote: A cloned corpus is someone else's claim.

decisions.decision: Research the truncated-change problem before building for it
decisions.rationale: The commit message states that research was done to understand the truncated-change problem, which is a significant issue affecting 59% of held-out changes.
decisions.quote: Research the truncated-change problem before building for it

decisions.decision: Open with the thing a Rust developer recognises: a dependency pinned to an exact version, a lock held across await, a test that builds its own fixture.
decisions.rationale: To make the documentation relatable and understandable for Rust developers.
decisions.quote: It now opens with the thing a Rust developer recognises: a dependency pinned to an exact version, a lock held across an await, a test that builds its own fixture.

decisions.decision: Show what the tool does rather than describe it.
decisions.rationale: To provide clear and practical information about the tool's functionality.
decisions.quote: Then what the tool does, shown rather than described, with real output from this repository:

decisions.decision: The model is the operator's choice, never the tool's
decisions.rationale: To leave the selection of the model to the user.
decisions.quote: The model is the operator's choice, never the tool's

decisions.decision: Whatever becomes a body is now joined into one paragraph
decisions.rationale: to keep every word the model wrote and avoid refusing the whole commit for a blank line
decisions.quote: Whatever becomes a body becomes one paragraph, wherever it came from — a model's rationale, or the overflow of a text too long to be a gist.

decisions.decision: A body as smysl's `fine` profile will take it: one paragraph
decisions.rationale: to ensure that the body is one paragraph and avoid refusal due to multiple assertions
decisions.quote: A model's rationale arrives as prose, sometimes with a blank line in it, and smysl refuses a unit whose body holds more than one assertion (SMY-E040). Refusing the whole commit for a blank line would throw away every call that produced it had already been paid for.

decisions.decision: The error named a `b3:` uid and nothing else
decisions.rationale: to improve error identification by showing more information
decisions.quote: the error named a `b3:` uid and nothing else. It now shows the unit's gist and the first lines of its body, which is what identified this bug in a minute after half an hour of not knowing.

decisions.decision: It did not say that the model's answers were already cached
decisions.rationale: to provide more accurate information about the caching status
decisions.quote: it did not say that the model's answers were already cached. They were, so `cargo smysl extract <rev>` after a fix costs no model calls — it took about a second here. The failure now says so, with the path.

decisions.decision: The commit that hit it is recorded, from cache
decisions.rationale: to ensure that the commit is recorded even if it was already cached
decisions.quote: The commit that hit it is recorded, from cache, and a test holds the case.

decisions.decision: A test holds the case
decisions.rationale: to verify that the fix works as expected
decisions.quote: The commit that hit it is recorded, from cache, and a test holds the case.

decisions.decision: Join bodies into one paragraph if they contain a blank line

decisions.quote: Whatever becomes a body is now joined into one paragraph, in the one place a body is chosen rather than at each call site

decisions.decision: Show the unit's gist and the first lines of its body in error messages
decisions.rationale: It now shows the unit's gist and the first lines of its body, which is what identified this bug in a minute after half an hour of not knowing.
decisions.quote: the error named a `b3:` uid and nothing else. It now shows the unit's gist and the first lines of its body

decisions.decision: Indicate that cached answers are used in failure messages

decisions.quote: it did not say that the model's answers were already cached. They were

decisions.decision: Hardcode the command list

Give each test its own scratch directory

Readers need it.

decisions.decision: The failure message now indicates that the model's answers were already cached
